blindSummary:
This state/province is included in the restive mountainous zone that a foreign home office's country-of-origin note (June 2025) singles out as the exception to its general finding of no state-persecution risk in the country. Several foreign governments name this state/province within their most severe travel-warning tier for the zone. The enforcement logic matches the zone's other parts: family honour norms and informal security structures can produce violence, detention, or forced return without legal process.

No secret-prison infrastructure of the scale documented in the zone's worst neighbour, and no explicit special-permission entry requirement, is documented for this state/province specifically. Local risk sits well below the country's severe national baseline — on par with two neighbouring states/provinces, and far worse than the country's central states/provinces, which inherit the national figure with no sub-national deviation.
